reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000708 (the melody read from 000708a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann Michael Haydn's dates (1737–1806) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Haydn_Michael (Haydn, Michael, 1737-1806); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Haydn (14 September 1737 - 10 August 1806). GREENLAND, LYONS and SALZBURG had borrowed Joseph Haydn's 1732-1809 through the surname-and-initial fallback.; CCEH's page gives none. B. Jacob has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1819, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1819, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000708a.nwc).
